Configuration

VIKI Agent reads supported path overrides when it starts. Set a variable before launching the app; changes take effect on the next launch. Most people can use the defaults.

VariablePurposeDefault
VIKI_VAULTUse a validated vault folder for this launch.The workspace selected in the app, or chat-only mode if none is selected.
VIKI_CLAUDE_CLIUse a specific Claude Code executable.In a source checkout, the CLI bundled with the installed SDK when it is present; otherwise your own Claude Code installation.
VIKI_EDGEUse a specific Chromium-family browser executable for the browser window.Windows: Microsoft Edge. macOS/Linux: the first supported Edge, Chrome or Chromium executable found; Linux skips snap and Flatpak launchers. VIKI Agent's own window does not need a browser.
VIKI_SERVERStart this VIKI Agent server executable from VIKI Agent's own window instead of the checkout's. An installed app ignores it and always runs its bundled server.uv run viki-agent in the checkout.
VIKI_DATA_DIRChoose where VIKI Agent keeps its local app data.See the platform defaults below.
LOCALAPPDATASet the base used for the default app data folder on Windows.The Windows local app data folder.
XDG_DATA_HOMESet the base used for the default app data folder on Linux.~/.local/share; relative values are ignored.

Set VIKI_EDGE to an explicit executable path to override browser discovery, then restart. Selecting an executable does not verify its compatibility.

For example, set a custom app data folder in PowerShell before starting:

$env:VIKI_DATA_DIR = "D:\viki-agent-data"
uv run viki-agent

On macOS or Linux, set the variable in the shell before running uv run viki-agent:

export VIKI_DATA_DIR="$HOME/viki-agent-data"
uv run viki-agent

VIKI Agent can't start with VIKI_DATA_DIR inside a vault, ~/.claude or ~/.codex, so keep the app data folder outside them. A relative VIKI_DATA_DIR is resolved from the launch directory.

01App data location

By default, VIKI Agent keeps its local app data here:

  • Windows
    %LOCALAPPDATA%\viki-agent (usually under your user profile).
  • macOS
    ~/Library/Application Support/viki-agent.
  • Linux
    $XDG_DATA_HOME/viki-agent, or ~/.local/share/viki-agent when XDG_DATA_HOME is unset or relative.

App data includes local application state and logs. VIKI_DATA_DIR moves only this folder; Claude Code's own login and configuration stay where Claude Code keeps them.

02Optional messaging

Set up Mattermost, Slack and Discord entirely in Messaging. Settings apply without restart.

  1. Fill in a provider's fields.
  2. Select Save changes.
  3. Turn it on.
  • Bots left on
    a bot you leave on reconnects on its own the next time VIKI Agent starts in the workspace you turned it on in. In any other workspace it stays off until you turn it on there.
  • Off
    the switch stops a running bot.
  • On
    the switch can renew a stopped connection after cleanup and any cooldown.
  • Remove saved settings
    deletes a provider's saved settings from this computer.

See Mattermost mobile access for trusted-server setup and Slack and Discord messaging for app scopes, the Discord client URL and platform commands.

03Decision settings

Decision's settings are on the Decision page, not in launch variables. A change applies without a restart. See What VIKI watches for its switches and What VIKI may do for each grant's default, daily limit and vault policy.

04Claude Code environment

VIKI Agent uses the normal Claude Code configuration.

  • CLAUDE_CONFIG_DIR
    leave it unset. When it is set, Claude Code cannot start from the app.
  • Claude Code sign-in or your own model
    sign in through Claude Code the same way you do in the terminal, with your Claude plan, an API key or a cloud provider, or add a Magpie model or routing group under Chat models in Settings › Providers. Manage provider API keys in Magpie.
  • Custom connections
    require Claude Code 2.1.281 or later, and support Chat Completions, Responses API and Anthropic Messages. To configure an endpoint without Magpie, open Advanced — Direct connections in Chat models.
  • Conflicts
    resolve any provider or authentication conflict reported in Providers before starting a chat.
  • Other sign-in methods
    Let Claude Code use its other sign-in methods in Settings › Chat is on by default and applies on the next launch. On, chats, routines and Bots that use Claude Code's own models start on whatever sign-in your Claude Code is set up with, and that account is billed. Off, chats start only on the Claude subscription sign-in, and a chat that would bill another account does not start. A chat on a model connection still refuses when Claude Code's settings would bill another account, so remove that setting to use connections; the change takes effect after VIKI Agent restarts.
  • Inherited variables
    VIKI Agent starts Claude Code without inherited ANTHROPIC_* and CLAUDE_CODE_* variables, so set an API key or provider in Claude Code's own settings.

Sessions running at once

Sessions running at once in Settings › Chat controls how many sessions can run Claude Code at the same time, 30 by default, any whole number from 1 to 999. Chats, routines and Bots all count. The setting applies to the next chat you start, with no restart. A lower number stops nothing that is running; new sessions can start once enough have closed. Each running session is its own Claude Code process and uses memory. The setting is stored as chat.max_live_sessions in the app settings document. An older VIKI Agent keeps the key but ignores it and runs at its own limit of 8.

Where VIKI Agent looks for Claude Code

VIKI Agent does not install or modify Claude Code; it only looks for it. Without VIKI_CLAUDE_CLI set, a source checkout uses the CLI bundled with the installed SDK when it is present. Otherwise, VIKI Agent looks for your own installation in the order Anthropic's installer and each package manager place it:

  • Windows
    %USERPROFILE%\.local\bin\claude.exe, then %LOCALAPPDATA%\Microsoft\WinGet\Links\claude.exe, then the WinGet package folder, then npm's global install under %APPDATA%\npm\node_modules\@anthropic-ai\claude-code\bin\claude.exe.
  • macOS
    ~/.local/bin/claude, then /opt/homebrew/bin/claude, then /usr/local/bin/claude.
  • Linux
    ~/.local/bin/claude.
  • Then, on every OS
    PATH.

When no Claude Code is found, Settings › Providers shows the install command for your OS with a Copy button and a link to Anthropic's setup guide.

  1. Install Claude Code.
  2. Restart VIKI Agent. It looks again only at the next launch.

Set VIKI_CLAUDE_CLI to use a Claude Code executable at another location instead.

Claude Code updates

VIKI Agent leaves your own installation's update setting as it is. Only the CLI bundled with the installed SDK, used in a source checkout, has its automatic updates paused.

Whether your own installation updates itself depends on how it was installed:

  • Anthropic's installer and npm installs
    update themselves.
  • WinGet, Homebrew and Linux package-manager installs
    update through their package manager (winget upgrade Anthropic.ClaudeCode, brew upgrade claude-code).

Settings › Providers flags a version older than the tested range.

For setup and the source-checkout commands, see Getting started. For the illustrated overview, see the visual guide.
